title: [Enhancement][snappi] Single asic support for test_pfc_no_congestion_throughput and test_pfc_port_congestion
author: amitpawar12
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the enhancement

Currently following testcases in snappi_tests/pfc/ folder:
test_pfc_no_congestion_throughput 
test_pfc_port_congestion

are specifically marked with multidut-tgen topology. This needs to be made generic so that it can be executed on single-asic DUTs as well.

### Current Behavior

Only runs for multidut-tgen (T2) topology. Needs to be supported on single-asic (T1) topology as well.

### Proposed Behavior

Check for dependencies for asic values and ensure that appropriate asic values are passed to functions (None for single-asic DUTs).

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
Following two testcases check for the behavior of DUT at line-rate in case of single-ingress-egress and two-ingress-one-egress setup. However, these testcases were ONLY support for multi-asic DUT. 
snappi_tests/pfc/test_pfc_no_congestion_throughput.py
snappi_tests/pfc/test_pfc_port_congestion.py

These testcases also need to be supported for single-ASIC DUTs as well. 

#### How did you do it?
- Added tgen keyword in topology for the both the testcases.
- Resolved the ASIC_VALUE in the helper file to ensure that for single-ASIC DUTs, asic_value is passed as None.
